desc: Derive the prime-exponent characterization of \(f(S_i/S_{i+1})\) and prove that prime choices are independent.
Establish bounded exponent height \(0\le e_i\le \sum_i v_p(A_i)\) for normalized walks.
Implement and validate the per-prime weighted bounded-height DP, including the zero-visited condition and zero-valuation edges.
Factor all \(A_i\), combine independent prime contributions, and produce stdin/stdout Python code.
